themes.title: Nvidia's Huang spy scandal shakes the AI trade
themes.summary: Nvidia's board opened an investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with an alleged China-linked spy, sending shares down 6.6% and triggering bipartisan Hill scrutiny plus a fresh push for chip export controls. The episode reframes the AI buildout as a single-point-of-failure risk around its most indispensable CEO.
themes.angle: The AI economy has no succession plan if its linchpin CEO becomes untouchable.

items.title: Nvidia shares fall as it probes alleged Chinese spy scandal
items.note: Board opened probe after Huang admitted affair; stock fell 6.6% per The Information.

items.title: AI's "too big to fail" CEO is facing a crisis with no backup
items.note: Concentration-risk case: a ~$4.5T company built around a single leader now faces a leadership vacuum.

items.title: US Lawmakers Demand Details on Nvidia Amid Jensen Huang Scandal
items.note: Bipartisan pressure escalates the affair to a national-security matter; export-control push likely next.

themes.title: Anthropic files S-1 as it releases a frontier-model wave
themes.summary: Anthropic confirmed its long-expected US IPO with an SEC S-1 filing, landing alongside a coordinated launch of new frontier models and a public-benefit fund. Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 target agentic coding and high-volume workloads at lower cost, framing economics as the battleground ahead of the listing.
themes.angle: The IPO is a referendum on whether frontier-lab economics can be proven before the market's patience runs out.

items.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
items.note: Public filing confirmed; The Information reports the model wave lands as the IPO nears.

items.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
items.note: Flagship said to lead agentic coding and cost 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.note: Fastest small model, aimed at summarisation, subagents and browser use.

items.title: Investing in the public benefit
items.note: Structures a growing public-benefit share stake ahead of the listing.

themes.title: Saudi Arabia funds $667m AI infrastructure push
themes.summary: PIF vehicle HUMAIN and the National Infrastructure Fund signed financing worth up to SAR2.5bn (~$667m) for AI compute and critical power infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, backing data-centre capacity of up to 1GW. The deal underlines how quickly the Kingdom is converting Vision 2030 ambition into concrete compute and energy assets.
themes.angle: Power, not chips, is the real constraint on Gulf AI buildout — and Saudi is financing it explicitly.

items.title: HUMAIN and Infra sign $667 million financing agreements to advance Saudi Arabia's AI infrastructure
items.note: SAR2.5bn deal for AI compute and power; 1GW data-centre capacity per Arabian Business; Arab News, Gulf Daily News and Zawya corroborated.

themes.title: Gulf governments lean hard into agentic, AI-native enterprise
themes.summary: The UAE AI Council is weighing a 50% agentic-AI shift across labour, energy and investment, while Abu Dhabi advances plans to become a first AI-native government and G42's US pivot invites questions about ownership. US midterm backlash is also testing Gulf AI ambitions in Washington.
themes.angle: GCC governments are becoming the primary buyers and architects of enterprise agentic AI — a market the West often underestimates.

items.title: US midterm backlash puts Gulf AI dreams to the test

themes.title: Infrastructure: TPUs, safety rails and agentic coding
themes.summary: Google unveiled new TPUs it calls more powerful and secure, OpenAI shipped a Control Room system to halt unsafe model workloads, and CodeRabbit scaled agentic software delivery 20x. DeepMind also added AI drug-discovery tools, pointing to a platform-vs-lab race for infrastructure and enterprise workflow software.
themes.angle: The real contest is shifting from raw model quality to the rails and workflows around inference.

items.title: Google Announces New TPUs It Says Are More Powerful and Secure
items.note: (via GN) New TPU generation pitches security and power alongside performance.

items.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.note: Customer case: 20x more software shipped by governing AI-written code.

items.title: Google DeepMind Adds AI Drug Discovery Tools to Antigravity Platform
items.note: (via GN) DeepMind pushes AI drug-discovery into its Antigravity platform.

themes.title: Security wake-up: hacks, RSA risk and enterprise AI sales
themes.summary: Fireworks AI told customers including Harvey about a second, more serious breach, DeepMind agents cut the cost of attacking legacy 1024-bit RSA, and Meta is courting consultancies to push AI into corporate accounts. The cluster underscores both escalating AI security exposure and a pivot to enterprise distribution.
themes.angle: Enterprise AI buyers now face a two-front risk: supply-chain breaches and the credibility of the models they deploy.

themes.title: Capital pivots as the AI sell-off bites
themes.summary: Altimeter is raising $3bn+ for private markets, SoftBank's giant bet is under pressure from the tech sell-off, and two China chipmakers hit Hong Kong public markets. Meanwhile Gulf sovereign funds committed a record $53.9bn in H1 2026 with tech the top sector, recalibrating the global capital map.
themes.angle: As Western AI valuations wobble, sovereign and private capital are re-pricing both risk and geography.
